tagline: Your real story, fitted to the job
brief: An Android app that turns a candidate's confirmed background and a job description into a tailored application, without inventing anything. Job seekers apply to many roles on their phone; the app should feel honest, friendly and quick, not like another grey document tool.
criteria: Success: reads at 16 px, works in one colour, matches the in-app mascot Paige, stands apart from blue document-and-checkmark resume tools.

concepts.name: Paige
concepts.idea: Paige, the app's own resume page with a face, is the brand: your story, friendly and true.
rationale: Same character the user meets on sign-in, job paste and tailoring, so the icon and the app tell one story
A face on a page is warmer than the category's grey documents, checkmarks and pencils
Solid silhouette with real cut-outs: survives 16 px, one colour and the Android themed icon

recommendation: Ship Paige as the launcher icon (ink on lime), use the lime-on-black lockup in the app and store listing, and the ink lockup on light surfaces.
